summary: Defines `InteractiveConversationElement`, an interface for swipeable/snapshotable chat message UI elements in Signal's conversation view, exposing bubble, reaction, reply, and contact photo views along with snapshot projection and strategy APIs.

`SenderNameWithLabelView` is a Compose-based Android custom view that renders a group message sender's name with an optional `MemberLabel` badge, designed for RecyclerView recycling in Signal conversation threads.

`ShrinkWrapLinearLayout` is a custom `LinearLayoutCompat` in the Signal Android conversation UI that overrides `EXACTLY` measure specs to `AT_MOST`, enabling proper `wrap_content` width behavior for chat message bubble views inside `ConstraintLayout`.

The `V2ConversationContext` interface provides adapter-scoped dependencies and state—such as lifecycle owner, Glide request manager, display mode, click listeners, multiselect parts, search query, chat colors, wallpaper, colorizer, and neighboring message records—to conversation item views in the Signal Android chat UI.

`V2ConversationItemLayout` is a `ConstraintLayout` subclass used as the base conversation item in Signal's Android chat UI, providing `OnMeasureListener` hooks for pre/post measure-pass manipulation and touch event dispatch delegation for message bubble layout.

File defining `V2ConversationItemMediaBindingBridge`, a pass-through data class that unifies incoming and outgoing media message view bindings in Signal's conversation UI for consistent rendering of media thumbnails, quotes, body text, reactions, and delivery status.

V2ConversationItemMediaViewHolder is an Android ViewHolder in Signal's conversation UI that binds and renders media-backed chat messages, handling thumbnail presentation, quoted message replies, media layout constraints, and multi-select interactions within the conversation message list.

`V2ConversationItemShape` determines chat bubble corner radii and spacing for message clustering in the Signal Android conversation UI, grouping consecutive messages by sender and time gap into single/start/middle/end shapes.

V2ConversationItemSnapshotStrategy is an Android Kotlin class that implements a snapshot drawing strategy for conversation bubble items during long-press reaction overlays in Signal's chat UI, temporarily resetting view scales and hiding sender elements before capturing the canvas.

`V2ConversationItemTextOnlyBindingBridge` is a data class and extension-function bridge that unifies incoming and outgoing text-only chat message view bindings in the Signal Android conversation UI, covering sender avatars, badges, emoji body text, reactions, delivery status, expiration timers, reply previews, and starred/pinned footer indicators.

`ConversationItemViewHolder` (Signal Android) renders individual chat messages in the conversation RecyclerView, handling body text styling (mentions, links, search highlights, spans), bubble layout transitions, multi-select interactions, long-click copy, chat colors, and message display modes.

V2ConversationItemTheme provides color theming for Signal Android conversation bubbles, including body text, footer text, reply icon, and bubble background colors based on message direction (incoming/outgoing), wallpaper presence, and special thread types like release notes.

`V2ConversationItemThumbnail` is a custom `AppCompatImageView` for rendering encrypted media thumbnails in Signal's conversation bubbles, handling foreground gradient shading, Glide image loading via `DecryptableUri`, and sizing logic for `MmsMessageRecord` slide attachments.

`V2ConversationItemUtils` is a Signal Android utility object for conversation message presentation, handling thumbnail-at-bottom-of-bubble layout decisions and linkifying URLs, emails, and phone numbers in message bodies with interceptable long-click copy-link spans.
Abstract base `V2ConversationItemViewHolder` class in Signal Android that provides shared shape and theme delegates for rendering conversation message bubble items in the chat UI.

`V2FooterPositionDelegate` is a layout delegate that determines whether conversation message footers (timestamp, delivery status, expiry, pinned, starred indicators) should be tucked beside the message body text or displayed underneath it in the Signal Android chat UI.

V2OnDispatchTouchEventListener handles touch-driven shrink-and-return animation of conversation message bubbles in the Signal Android chat UI, relevant for long-press scaling, bubble interaction, and condensed display mode.

Enum `V2Payload` defines the conversation V2 UI event payloads (search query updates, inline content playback, wallpaper, message request state) emitted between conversation components in Signal's SecureMessaging app.

`AttachmentKeyboardFragment` is a Signal Android fragment that manages the attachment keyboard UI in conversations, handling media selection, button filtering (payments, polls), and permission-gated attachment actions via `AttachmentKeyboard` and `AttachmentKeyboardViewModel`.

AttachmentKeyboardViewModel is an Android ViewModel that exposes an RxJava Observable stream of recent media (photos/videos) from MediaRepository for the conversation keyboard attachment picker in Signal.

`AddToFolderBottomSheet` is a Compose-based bottom sheet dialog fragment in Signal's conversation list module that lets users add chat threads (individual, group, or other) to chat folders, using `ConversationListViewModel` and `ChatFolderRecord` for folder selection UI.

ChatFolderAdapter is a RecyclerView MappingAdapter that renders chat folder tabs on the conversation list, handling folder selection state, unread count badges, and long-press context menu actions (edit, mute, unmute, mark all read) via a Callbacks interface for ChatFolderRecord domain objects.

`ChatFolderMappingModel` is a Parcelable data class and `MappingModel` implementation representing chat folder UI state—including unread count, muted/empty/selected flags—for use in the `ChatFolderAdapter` within Signal's conversation list folder feature.

ClearFilterViewHolder is a RecyclerView.ViewHolder in Signal's conversation list module that renders a clear-filter UI element with a tip tooltip, triggered when a Conversation's ThreadRecord type is TYPE_SHOW_TIP from the ConversationReader.

ConversationFilterBehavior extends AppBarLayout.Behavior to control collapsible toolbar (app bar) expansion/collapse gestures in the conversation list, delegating scroll lifecycle decisions to a Callback for filtering interactions.
`ConversationFilterLatch` is an enum state machine with `SET` and `RESET` states that tracks pull-to-filter actions on the conversation list in Signal's Android app.

ConversationListAdapter is a RecyclerView ListAdapter that renders the Signal messenger conversation list, managing multiple view types (chat threads, headers, placeholders, empty states, filter-clear footers), typing indicators, multi-selection, paging, and Glide-based avatar loading.

`ConversationListArchiveFragment` extends `ConversationListFragment` to render the archived conversations list UI, handling RecyclerView setup, empty-state display, folders, and lifecycle-bound RxJava subscriptions for Signal Android's conversation list feature.

`ConversationListArchiveItemDecoration` is a RecyclerView ItemDecoration that fills the visual gap during archive animations in the Signal conversation list to hide archived rows from peeking through.

Abstract base class `ConversationListDataSource` implementing `PagedDataSource` for Signal's chat/conversation list, providing paged loading of archived and unarchived conversation threads with filtering by `ChatFolderRecord` and `ConversationFilter`.

`ConversationListFragment` is the Android Fragment in Signal that renders the main messaging conversation list UI, handling RecyclerView display, swipe-to-archive/delete actions, search, toolbar collapse behavior, and navigation into individual chat threads.

Fragment extension function `listenToEventBusWhileResumed` that manages EventBus subscription lifecycle for clearing conversation search when entering a message in the Signal Android conversation list, handling split-pane vs compact form factors and predictive back navigation.

ConversationListSearchAdapter is a RecyclerView adapter in Signal's conversation list search UI that wires up chat thread, message, group, and chat filter rendering using the ContactSearchAdapter/ContactSearchKey/ContactSearchData paged contact search framework.

`ConversationListItemAction` is a FrameLayout-based view that implements `BindableConversationListItem` to render the "archived conversations" action row in the Signal conversation list, displaying the count of unread archived threads.

ConversationListItemAnimator is a custom RecyclerView ItemAnimator for the Signal Android conversation list that controls move/change animation durations and provides enable/disable toggling for list item transitions.

`ConversationListViewModel` is a sealed ViewModel that manages paged conversation list state, chat folder filtering, archive status, and read/unread interactions for the Signal Android messenger's inbox UI.

`ConversationListSearchModels` is a Kotlin object that provides `MappingModel` and `MappingViewHolder` registrations for the Signal Android conversation list search adapter, covering domain concepts like thread search results, message search results, group-with-members results, contact search, and `ConversationSet` display in RecyclerView and Compose.
`JoinMembersComparator` is a `Comparator<String>` that sorts display names by prioritizing those containing a highlight substring, used for ordering join-members lists in Signal's conversation UI.

`ConversationListItem` is a custom Android `ConstraintLayout` view that renders a single row in the Signal messenger conversation list, handling avatar display, recipient names, message snippets, typing indicators, unread counts, delivery status icons, badges, pinned/archived states, search highlighting, and formatting for diverse message types including calls, drafts, group updates, disappearing messages, view-once media, and polls.
`RestoreCompleteBottomSheetDialog` is a Compose bottom sheet dialog in Signal's device transfer flow that displays a restore/transfer completion confirmation to the user.

`TimestampPayloadSupport` is a generic interface in the Signal Android conversation list module that enables adapters to update row timestamps incrementally via payload notifications instead of full item rebinding, relevant for developers searching for conversation list performance optimization, partial RecyclerView updates, or timestamp display logic.

Parcelable data class `ConversationFilterRequest` encapsulates a `ConversationFilter` and its `ConversationFilterSource` for passing chat filter state between Android components in the Signal conversation list filtering feature.

`RelinkDevicesReminderBottomSheetFragment` is a Signal Android Compose bottom sheet dialog that prompts users to relink their linked devices after re-registration, using `ComposeBottomSheetDialogFragment` with Material3 UI components.

Enum `ConversationFilterSource` defines the origin points for chat list filtering in the Signal Android app, tracking whether a conversation filter was triggered by a pull-to-filter drag gesture or the overflow menu, useful for developers searching for chat filter UI interaction sources, conversation list filtering, or pull-to-filter gesture handling.

ConversationListFilterPullView is an Android FrameLayout that implements a push/pull latch gesture UI for enabling and disabling conversation list chat filters in Signal, managing filter pull state transitions (open/closed), haptic feedback, and animated visual transitions.

`FilterCircleView` is a custom Android `View` that renders an animated filter-selection circle with progressive stroke animations and a rounded-rectangle transition for the chat conversation list filter UI in Signal.

`FilterLerp` is a utility object in the Signal Android app's chat filter feature that provides linear interpolation functions for animating the filter pull UI, including pill positioning, circle padding, and alpha transparency transitions.
`ProgressVelocityTracker` tracks scroll/fling velocity as percent-per-second using a ring buffer of progress and duration samples for chat list filtering animations.
The `FilterPullState` enum defines the gesture-driven lifecycle states (CLOSED, OPEN_APEX, CANCELING, OPENING, OPEN, CLOSE_APEX, CLOSING) of a pull-to-filter UI control in a chat conversation list.

Generic fixed-capacity ring buffer (circular queue) backed by AndroidX's `CircularArray`, providing add, size, clear, and indexed access for buffering a bounded number of elements in the chat/conversation list filtering domain.

The `Conversation` class wraps a `ThreadWithRecipient` with a `Type` enum (THREAD, PINNED_HEADER, UNPINNED_HEADER, ARCHIVED_FOOTER, CONVERSATION_FILTER_FOOTER, CONVERSATION_FILTER_EMPTY, CHAT_FOLDER_EMPTY, ARCHIVED_EMPTY, EMPTY) representing UI list items in the Signal Android conversation/chat list.

`ConversationFilter` is an enum defining filter modes (OFF, UNREAD, MUTED, GROUPS) for the conversation list in Signal Android, used by developers searching for chat filtering, conversation list display, unread/muted/group chat visibility.

`ConversationReader` extends `ThreadTable.StaticReader` to read conversation list cursors in Signal Android, mapping header/footer rows (pinned, unpinned, archived, filter tips) into `ThreadWithRecipient` models for the chat list UI.

`ConversationSet` is a delegating wrapper around a `Set<Conversation>` that provides thread-ID-based lookup via `containsThreadId`, used for managing collections of messaging conversations/threads in the SecureSignal (Signal) conversation list.

The `UnreadPayments` abstract class models unread payment notifications in the conversation list, with subclasses for single-recipient (showing sender name and amount) and multiple-recipient (showing unread count) cases, used for rendering payment notification UI in Signal's messaging interface.

`UnreadPaymentsLiveData` is a LiveData that observes the payments database and emits a list of unread/unseen payment transactions, used for surfacing payment notifications (single or multiple) in the conversation list.

`CrashConfig` is a Kotlin object in Signal's Android app that parses remote-config-driven crash patterns (`CrashPattern`) — substring matchers on exception name, message, and stack trace — used to identify and prompt users about specific crashes stored in the local crash database.
The `AsymmetricMasterCipher` class provides asymmetric encryption for local message data using ECDH key agreement and ephemeral keypairs in the Signal secure messaging application.

`AttachmentSecretProvider` is a singleton that manages creation, retrieval, and KeyStore-backed encryption of `AttachmentSecret` cryptographic keys used to encrypt and decrypt file attachments in Signal.

The `AsymmetricMasterSecret` class holds an ECC keypair (ECPublicKey/ECPrivateKey) used during initial TextSecure/Signal key generation for asymmetric encryption.

`ClassicDecryptingPartInputStream` provides static factory methods for creating AES/CBC-decrypting input streams over encrypted Signal message attachment files, handling IV extraction, MAC verification, and cipher initialization against an `AttachmentSecret` for secure media part decryption.

The `DatabaseSecret` class in the Signal Android crypto package wraps a symmetric encryption key for database encryption, providing conversions between raw byte array and hex-encoded string representations.

`DatabaseSecretProvider` is a thread-safe singleton that manages SQLCipher database encryption key creation, caching, and migration from plaintext to Android KeyStore-sealed storage in the Signal messaging app.

`IdentityKeyParcelable` is a Parcelable wrapper for libsignal `IdentityKey` objects in Signal's crypto package, used for serializing and deserializing identity keys when passing them between Android components via Intents or Bundles.
`InvalidPassphraseException` is a custom exception class in the Signal (SecureSMS) crypto package thrown when a user-supplied passphrase fails validation during encryption or decryption operations.
`KeyStoreHelper` provides Android KeyStore-backed AES-GCM encryption and decryption (`seal`/`unseal`) for protecting sensitive secrets in the Signal secure messaging app.

`MasterCipher` provides AES-CBC encryption and HMAC-SHA1 authentication for local storage of message bodies and private keys, using a `MasterSecret` for at-rest data protection in Signal's crypto layer.

MasterSecret class represents TextSecure/Signal's master cryptographic secret containing a 128-bit AES encryption key and 160-bit HMAC-SHA1 MAC key, implementing Parcelable for secure serialization of the app's core symmetric keys used in end-to-end encrypted messaging.

`MasterSecretUtil` is a Signal Android crypto utility class for generating, storing, and managing the app's `MasterSecret` encryption key and its passphrase-protected asymmetric key pair using Curve25519, PBE, and AES/HMAC.

`ModernDecryptingPartInputStream` provides static factory methods for creating AES/CTR-decrypting input streams that read encrypted attachment files using HMAC-derived keys and supports random-access offset decryption for Signal messaging attachment storage.

`ModernEncryptingPartOutputStream` is a utility that creates AES/CTR-encrypted `OutputStream` instances for writing encrypted attachment files to disk using an `AttachmentSecret`, with helper methods for computing plaintext length from ciphertext.
ProfileKeyUtil is a utility class in Signal's crypto package for creating, parsing, and converting ZKGroup ProfileKey instances from raw bytes, Base64 strings, or the current user's self profile.

`PublicKey` class in Signal's crypto package that wraps an elliptic curve `ECPublicKey` with a numeric key ID, providing serialization and deserialization of public keys for end-to-end encrypted messaging key exchange.

`ReentrantSessionLock` is a singleton enum implementing `SignalSessionLock` via a `ReentrantLock`, providing thread-safe session mutual exclusion and lock ownership checking for the Signal messaging crypto layer.
`PreKeyUtil` is a utility class that generates, stores, and archives one-time elliptic curve (EC) and Kyber (KEM) pre-keys for Signal protocol cryptographic key exchange.

The `SecurityEvent` class in Signal's crypto package broadcasts security update intents (`KEY_EXCHANGE_UPDATE`) to notify components of key exchange events, relevant for developers searching for security events, key exchange notifications, broadcast intents, and cryptographic session updates.

`SenderKeyUtil` is a utility class for managing Signal Protocol sender key lifecycle operations — rotating, querying creation time, and clearing all sender key state — used in group messaging encryption and re-registration flows.

`SealedSenderAccessUtil` provides static methods for constructing sealed sender access credentials, validating sender certificates, and determining unidentified delivery modes (individual and group send) for Signal recipients.
`PreKeyMetadataStore` interface for persisting Signal protocol prekey state metadata including signed prekey rotation, EC one-time prekey IDs, and Kyber post-quantum prekey tracking.

`SignalKyberPreKeyStore` is a database-backed implementation of the Libsignal `KyberPreKeyStore` interface that manages post-quantum Kyber pre-keys (storage, retrieval, last-resort keys, and key-usage marking) for Signal's encrypted messaging key exchange.

`SignalBaseIdentityKeyStore` is a shared backing store for Signal Protocol identity keys (ACI/PNI) that caches and persists peer identity key records, trust verification status, and registration IDs via `IdentityTable` for use by the libsignal `IdentityKeyStore` interface.

`SignalIdentityKeyStore` implements the Signal Protocol `IdentityKeyStore` interface, wrapping `SignalBaseIdentityKeyStore` to support multiple identity key pairs (ACI/PNI) over shared storage for identity key management, trust verification, and recipient identity persistence.

`SignalSenderKeyStore` implements `SignalServiceSenderKeyStore` to persist and retrieve Signal Protocol sender keys and sender-key-sharing state via `SenderKeyTable` and `SenderKeySharedTable` for group messaging distribution.

`SignalServiceDataStoreImpl` implements `SignalServiceDataStore` to route crypto storage operations to the correct per-account data store (ACI or PNI) based on the `ServiceId`, supporting multi-device Signal accounts.

`SignalServiceAccountDataStoreImpl` implements the Signal Protocol's `SignalServiceAccountDataStore` interface, aggregating identity key, pre-key, session, sender key, and Kyber pre-key stores for encrypted messaging key management in the Signal Android app.

`TextSecurePreKeyStore` implements Signal's `SignalServicePreKeyStore` and `SignedPreKeyStore` interfaces, providing thread-safe database-backed storage and retrieval of one-time pre-keys and signed pre-keys keyed by `ServiceId` for the Signal messaging protocol's X3DH key agreement.

`TextSecureSessionStore` implements `SignalServiceSessionStore` to persist and load Signal Protocol session records (`SessionRecord`) for a given `ServiceId`/`SignalProtocolAddress` pair via `SessionTable`, handling session storage, retrieval, bulk loading, and containment checks with reentrant locking.

`AttachmentMetadataTable` is a Signal Android SQLite database table class that manages attachment metadata storage, indexed by plaintext hash with optional local backup encryption keys, supporting insert-with-dedup and cursor-based metadata reads.

This file defines the `AttachmentDatabase` class in Signal's SecureSMS app, providing SQLite CRUD operations for managing message attachments including media storage, blurhash thumbnails, transform properties, backup/restore of media items, and attachment upload tracking.

`ArchivedMediaTable` is a Signal Android database table that tracks media attachment snapshots and pending states to coordinate backup uploads, CDN reconciliation, and safe deletion of archived media objects by snapshot version.
BodyAdjustment data class in the Signal Android database package representing a text body mutation operation, tracking startIndex, oldLength, and newLength for message body content transformations.

Extension function `adjustBodyRanges` on `BodyRangeList` that recalculates mention/BodyRange start positions and lengths after message text is shortened by replacing mention names with placeholders, relevant for message body text adjustment, mention rendering, and BodyAdjustment offset recalculation.

`CallLinkTable` is a SQLite database table class for persisting ad-hoc call link details in Signal, including root keys, room IDs, admin keys, restrictions, revocation status, and expiration for WebRTC call links.

`CdsTable` is a SQLite database table class in Signal's Android app that tracks E164 phone numbers previously queried via the Contact Discovery Service (CDS) to support rate-limiting by distinguishing new from previously-seen numbers.

CallTable is a database table class in Signal that manages storage and retrieval of 1:1 call records, handling call metadata including peer recipients, call types and directions, call events, timestamps, read status, and call synchronization across devices.

ChatColorsTable is a SQLite database table class in Signal Android that manages CRUD operations for custom chat color schemes (ChatColors), supporting auto, built-in, and custom color ID types for conversation theming.

ChatFolderTables is a Signal Android database table class that manages chat folder records and chat folder memberships, supporting CRUD operations for organizing conversation threads into user-defined and default "All Chats" folders with sync to remote storage.

The `CollapsedState` enum defines the collapse/expand display state of grouped update messages (like group updates) in a messaging conversation, supporting NONE, HEAD_COLLAPSED, HEAD_EXPANDED, COLLAPSED, EXPANDED, and PENDING_COLLAPSED states.

`CollapsibleEvents` is a utility object that classifies Signal messages into collapsible event types — `CALL_EVENT`, `DISAPPEARING_TIMER`, and `CHAT_UPDATE` — so consecutive system messages (call logs, expiration timer changes, profile/identity updates, pinned messages, polls, number changes, and GV2 group changes) can be visually grouped in the conversation thread.

`CursorRecyclerViewAdapter` is an abstract RecyclerView adapter that wraps an Android `Cursor` with `DataSetObserver` auto-updates and optional header/footer views, used for database-backed list rendering in Signal.

`DatabaseMonitor` is a singleton that intercepts and delegates SQL operations (query, insert, update, delete) to a pluggable `QueryMonitor` for database query logging and debugging in the Signal Android app.

`DatabaseObserver` is a listener/observer registry for fine-grained database change notifications across Signal's domain concepts including conversations, conversation lists, messages, recipients, payments, stickers, stories, call links, notification profiles, scheduled messages, chat folders, and starred messages.
Kotlin extension functions on `DatabaseObserver` that expose Signal attachment deletion and attachment update events as reactive `Flow<Unit>` streams using a `callbackFlow` helper.

`DatabaseTable` is the abstract base class for Signal Android's SQLite database table helpers, providing shared infrastructure for recipient ID and thread ID database references, conversation/sticker listener notifications, and database access across the messaging app's persistence layer.

DistributionListTables manages story distribution lists (audience privacy, membership, and storage sync) for Signal's stories feature, exposing CRUD operations on DistributionListRecord, DistributionListId, DistributionId, and PrivacyMode for grouping recipients into story audiences.

`DonationReceiptTable` is a Signal Android database table class that manages CRUD operations for in-app donation receipt records, storing payment details like amount, currency, receipt type, and subscription level.

DraftTable is a Signal Android database class that manages message draft storage (text, voice notes) keyed by thread ID, supporting CRUD operations for composing, retrieving, and clearing drafts within conversation threads.

`EarlyDeliveryReceiptCache` is an LRU-based in-memory cache in Signal's database layer that tracks early delivery receipt counts and timestamps keyed by message target timestamp and `RecipientId`, supporting search for terms like delivery receipts, message read receipts, receipt caching, and early receipt deduplication.

EmojiSearchTable is a Signal Android database table class that provides full-text search over emoji by label and character, returning ranked results sorted by relevance using a similarity scoring algorithm.

`GroupReceiptTable` is a Signal Android SQLite database helper that manages the `group_receipts` table for tracking per-recipient message delivery status (undelivered, delivered, read, viewed, skipped, failed) and timestamps for group MMS messages.

`IdentityTable` is a Signal Android database table class that manages identity key records (via `IdentityRecord`/`IdentityStoreRecord`) for cryptographic identity storage, retrieval, verification, and sync across recipients.

GroupDatabase provides SQLite CRUD operations for managing Signal group records, including group membership, pending members, send endorsements, group secret/master keys, and group metadata within the Signal secure messaging application.

`InAppPaymentSubscriberTable` is a SQLite database table in Signal's Android app that maps `SubscriberId` records to currency codes, subscription types, and payment method details (Google Play purchase tokens, iOS transaction IDs) for in-app payment subscription management.

`InAppPaymentTable` is an Android SQLite database table class in Signal that manages in-app payment records for donations, gift badges, boost badges, subscription badges, and backup subscriptions including their state, type, and redeemable token lifecycle.

`JobDatabase` is a SQLCipher-backed SQLiteOpenHelper that persists job manager data — including `JobSpec`, `ConstraintSpec`, `DependencySpec`, and `FullSpec` — for the Signal Android app's background job scheduling and queue system.

`IssueReporter` is a Signal Android singleton that records runtime issues (slow database writes/reads/locks) to `LogDatabase` with configurable `IssuePriority`-based notification thresholds and debouncing for non-internal users.
`KeyValueDatabase` is a SQLCipher-backed SQLiteOpenHelper that persists key-value pairs in a separate encrypted database file for the Signal app's `KeyValueStore` configuration system.

`KyberPreKeyTable` is a SQLite-backed database table in Signal Android that manages post-quantum Kyber pre-key records (including last-resort keys, key IDs, and staleness timestamps) for ACI and PNI `ServiceId` accounts as part of the Signal Protocol's key exchange and storage layer.

`LastResortKeyTupleTable` is a Signal Android SQLite database table that stores unique tuples of (kyberPreKeyId, signedKeyId, baseKey) to detect and prevent reuse of last-resort Kyber post-quantum pre-keys during message decryption.

LocalMetricsDatabase is a SQLCipher-backed SQLiteOpenHelper that stores local performance metrics events (event name, split name, duration, timestamps) with automatic 7-day expiry for debug logging in Signal.

LogDatabase is a SQLCipher-backed SQLiteOpenHelper singleton that manages a dedicated, performance-critical database for storing, querying, and pruning application log entries and diagnostic issue entries in Signal.

MediaTable is a database access class in Signal's Android app that queries a SQL view over the AttachmentTable to retrieve media attachments (images, video, audio, stickers, voice notes, GIFs) associated with message threads and recipients for gallery/document browsing.

`MegaphoneDatabase` is a SQLCipher-backed SQLiteOpenHelper that manages persistence of megaphone records (snoozeable user-facing prompts/notifications) tracking events, interaction counts, visibility timestamps, and view cycles in the Signal Android app.

`MentionTable` is a SQLite database table class in Signal Android that manages user mention records (@-mentions) within chat messages, storing recipient IDs, message/thread references, and text range positions for querying and inserting mentions.

`MentionUtil` in `org.thoughtcrime.securesms.database` handles parsing and replacing @-mention placeholders in message bodies with display names or object-replacement characters, working with `Mention`, `MessageRecord`, `Recipient`, and `BodyRangeList` for Signal chat message rendering.

The `MessageType` enum defines categorized message types — including normal messages, payments notifications, story reactions, group updates, identity/safety number changes, expiration updates, contact joins, poll terminations, and pinned messages — serving as an abstraction over raw `MessageTypes` bitmasks in the Signal Android messaging database layer.

The `Database` class in the Signal Android (`securesms`) app is the core SQLite database helper managing messaging domain concepts such as conversations/threads, messages, recipients, identities/keys, and attachments via `ContentValues`-based CRUD queries and transactions.

`MessageLogDatabase` (Signal Android) manages a rolling buffer of outgoing message payloads, recipient-device delivery tracking, and related-message associations to support sender key retry logic for undelivered secure messages.

`NameCollisionTables` manages name collision detection and state tracking for recipients and group memberships in the Signal messaging database, handling display name hash comparisons, thread associations, and profile change timeouts to identify potential name spoofing or confusion scenarios.
Exception class `NoSuchMessageException` thrown when a requested message cannot be found in the Signal SecureMessaging database layer.
`NotInDirectoryException` is a custom throwable in the Signal Android database layer, thrown when a lookup fails because an entry is not found in a directory or contact list.
`NotificationProfileTables` is the Signal Android database layer for creating, querying, and syncing notification profiles, their schedules, and allowed-member recipient lists.

`ObservableContent` is an interface extending `Closeable` that defines a contract for registering and unregistering Android `ContentObserver` instances against observable database-backed content in the Signal Android (SecureSMS) app.

`OneTimePreKeyTable` is a Signal Android database class managing SQLite storage of one-time prekeys (ephemeral elliptic-curve key pairs) for Signal protocol X3DH key exchange, supporting PNI (phone number identity) and ACI service IDs.

`PartFileProtector` is a thread-safe utility that temporarily shields newly created message part/attachment files from premature deletion using a 10-minute in-memory protection window, relevant for media storage cleanup, attachment lifecycle, and file garbage collection in the Signal Android database layer.

`PaymentMetaDataUtil` is a utility class in the Signal payments database layer that constructs `PaymentMetaData` protocol buffer objects from MobileCoin receipts, transactions, key images, and public keys for identifying transaction outputs (TXOs).

`PaymentTable` is a SQLite database table class in Signal's Android app that manages cryptocurrency payment records, supporting queries and CRUD operations for MobileCoin transactions, payment states, amounts, fees, and recipient associations.

PollDatabase class managing SQLite CRUD operations for chat poll messages, including poll creation, option tracking, vote casting/removal, vote counting, and voter state within the Signal Android messaging app.

`ReactionTable` is a SQLite-backed database table class in Signal Android that manages emoji reactions on messages, supporting CRUD operations keyed by `MessageId`, `RecipientId` (author), and emoji for the messaging reaction model domain.

`RxDatabaseObserver` is a singleton that exposes RxJava `Flowable` streams for observing database changes to conversations, notification profiles, chat folders, and starred messages in the Signal messaging app.
